shaping.source: Chen et al. IJCAI 2023, Section 5.5, Eqs. (6)-(7)
shaping.omega_note: 1.0 is THIS round's pre-fixed setting, not a claimed paper default; no weight is swept
shaping.no_scaling: no rescaling is applied to either arm; r_t and c_t are both node counts, so omega=1 makes the shaped reward numerically larger -- mean_abs_reward is recorded for both arms so this is visible
shaping.fairness_caveat: the shaping term does not guarantee the original objective's optimal policy is preserved, so final quality is judged ONLY by raw sigma(S), never by shaped return

pipeline.buffering: whole episode, inserted at episode end
pipeline.insertion: each transition inserted once, with its own arm's reward
pipeline.checkpoint_reported: the policy at the pre-determined budget, NOT best validation

cost_views.primary: same total query cap (36369); counts training, leave-one-out and validation queries
cost_views.auxiliary: same episode count (2000), from the common checkpoint

degree.note: no cascade query is used to choose; degrees are read directly
